Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (public fleet list/detail contain 36 frames & 6 terms for Hiace, empty frames for Elf, static frame assets 200 image/jpeg, owner PATCH round-trip persisted and restored to original 36 frames + 6 terms, unauthenticated PATCH blocked, no _id leakage, 404 for unknown id). Frontend: hero 'Interior 360°' + fleet-hero-360-start opens photo-sphere-tour with 3 scene tabs; gallery thumbnails/prev/next/lightbox work; facilities (9 items) & terms (6 items) tabs work; WA/booking/quotation CTAs have correct hrefs; Exterior360 fully functional (initial 1/36, drag 1->16, slider scrub, prev/next ±1, wrap-around 1->36, auto-rotate runs and pause stops, aria-label switches Jeda/Putar otomatis, 36 frames preloaded with progress overlay); Elf unit correctly hides fleet-exterior-360 while hero tour still works; catalog /fleet regression OK (3 cards, click navigates to detail). CMS: owner login -> /app/vehicles -> edit Hiace -> Konten Web panel (open by default for units with media) shows vf-ext360-pattern/count/start/generate, generator produced 8 frames (f-1..f-8 visible in GalleryManager + toast '8 frame dibuat dari pola') and vf-ext360-count-info says '8 frame'; vf-rental-terms prefilled with 6 lines; cancelled without saving — demo data verified intact (36 frames + 6 terms). No console errors on any page. Only one real defect found: unreadable active scene-tab label in the hero tour (contrast).

issues: Active scene tab label is invisible: FleetDetail passes className '[&_button]:text-white/80' to PhotoSphereTour, which overrides the active tab's dark text. Computed style on [data-testid='tour-scene-depan'] = color rgba(255,255,255,0.8) on background rgb(239,242,245) (~1.1:1 contrast) — 'Kabin Depan' is unreadable on desktop and mobile. Suggested fix: scope the override to inactive tabs only (e.g. use data-[state]/aria-selected variants) or drop the [&_button] override.
Minor: on mobile (390px) the ext360-counter badge sits above the image on the card background; readable but visually detached from the frame.

action_items: Fix hero tour scene-tab contrast in /app/frontend/src/features/public/FleetDetail.jsx line ~112 ([&_button]:text-white/80 makes the ACTIVE tab label white-on-white).
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleFormDialog useEffect depends on the `initial` object identity (line 56-82); if the vehicles list refetches/polls while the dialog is open, form state and showWeb are reset and in-progress edits (e.g. generated 360 frames) would be silently discarded. Consider keying on initial.id only.

Exterior360 preloads ALL frames before enabling interaction (ready flag). 36 frames is fine, but the editor allows up to 120 — consider progressive readiness (enable after first N frames) to avoid a long loading overlay for large sets.
Exterior360 img.onerror = img.onload means broken frame URLs still count as 'loaded' and render as broken images with no user-visible warning; acceptable but worth a fallback.
